data.name: Faarihah
data.gender_notes: Faarihah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Faarihah means liberator or one who sets free. In Islamic tradition, this name holds deep spiritual significance as it represents the liberation of the soul from earthly desires and the ultimate release from the shackles of the material world. The name Faarihah carries the meaning “Liberator” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faarihah usually hope their child will grow to embody liberator and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes spiritual liberation and enlightenment in Islam.
data.etymology: Faarihah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Liberator.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faarihah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
